summary: Single-file living 3D worlds in Three.js, tuned for laptop iGPUs · Laptop ekran kartına uygun, tek dosyalık canlı 3D Three.js dünyaları
key_features: Vapur (https://furkiozknn.github.io/canli-dunyalar/worlds/vapur/): an Istanbul-style strait where timetabled ferries give way to a tanker, with poyraz, lodos and fog weather and a night mode
Balon (https://furkiozknn.github.io/canli-dunyalar/worlds/balon/): a Cappadocia-style valley where 12 hot-air balloons keep altitude separation and chase trucks follow the predicted landing
Each world is one index.html with no build step, written from one prompt in prompts/ using a six-block template with a dedicated Performance block
Tuned for laptop iGPUs: pixel ratio capped at 1.5, one shadow map, instanced meshes; ?low drops shadows and particles, ?record hides the UI for screen capture

social.headline: Two living 3D worlds, each a single HTML file, that run on a laptop's built-in graphics.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written from the README; no field is generated from a guess
